description: Create, list, update, or delete isolated multi-tenant brand or client profiles within a Nuntior workspace, including default timezone, X Smart Link optimization strategy, and automatic media aspect-ratio fitting rules. Use this tool to segment social accounts by brand, business unit, or agency client so credentials and posts never mix across profiles. Returns the list of profiles or the newly created/updated/deleted `Profile` record persisted in Nuntior Cloud.

action.description: Profile lifecycle operation to perform: 'list' all profiles in the workspace, 'create' a new isolated brand profile, 'update' an existing profile's settings, or 'delete' a profile by ID.

autoAdjustMedia.description: When true, automatically reframes and transcodes uploaded images and videos to match each destination social network's required aspect ratio (9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:5).

defaultXLinkStrategy.description: Default X (Twitter) link placement policy for this profile: 'first_reply' moves external URLs to an automatic 1st reply (saving 85% in X API link fees and avoiding reach penalties), 'inline' keeps links in the main post, and 'bio' references the profile bio link.

handleSlug.description: URL-friendly canonical handle slug (e.g. 'allometrik') used to verify social handle consistency across connected platforms.

name.description: Human-readable brand, executive, or client display name for the profile (e.g. 'Allometrik Official' or 'Acme Corp').

profileId.description: Target profile identifier (e.g. 'prof_allometrik'). Required for 'update' and 'delete' actions; optional custom ID when creating a profile.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g. 'Europe/Madrid', 'America/New_York', 'Asia/Dubai') used for queue scheduling and best-time-to-post analytics.

name: profiles_manage
title: Manage Multi-Tenant Brand Profiles
